description: SMA Technologies / Continuous OpCon workload-automation REST API integration. Each declared OpCon Daily Job becomes a daily-partitioned Dagster asset with a retry policy, via a client abstraction (submit/poll) shared by demo and real mode so the same calling logic runs either way. Scaffold (force-restart/hold/release/cancel/reconciliation ops+jobs, inbound-trigger sensor) is opt-in via generate_* flags, off by default. demo_mode=true (default) uses a demo client that logs a simulated REST lifecycle (token exchange + scheduleactions + dailyjobs status polling) on stdout -- OpCon is on-prem software with no public Docker image.

outputs.description: One daily-partitioned Dagster asset per OpCon Daily Job + optional source-table assets + opt-in ops/jobs/sensors/schedule.

demo_mode.label: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Use the demo client (logs a simulated REST lifecycle, no external calls) instead of the real REST client.

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.description: OpCon REST API base URL (used when demo_mode=false); scheduleactions/dailyjobs/tokens are relative to this.

jobs.label: Jobs
jobs.description: OpCon Daily Jobs to wrap as daily-partitioned Dagster assets. Each item: {job_name, asset_name, description?, schedule_name?, machine?, department?, force_restart?, deps?} -- deps is per-job, not shared.

source_tables.label: Source Tables
source_tables.description: Tables loaded by OpCon that Dagster observes (adds to lineage). Each item: {table_name, asset_name, description?, group_name?, produced_by?}.

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Dagster asset group for the job assets.

opcon_user_env.label: OpCon User Env Var
opcon_user_env.description: Env var holding the OpCon username for token exchange.

opcon_password_env.label: OpCon Password Env Var
opcon_password_env.description: Env var holding the OpCon password for token exchange.

poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval Seconds
poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between OpCon daily-job status polls (real mode only -- demo mode doesn't sleep).

poll_timeout_seconds.label: Poll Timeout Seconds
poll_timeout_seconds.description: Total seconds to wait for terminal state before failing.

partition_start_date.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start_date.description: Start date for the daily partitioned assets.

generate_external_monitor_sensor.label: Generate External Monitor Sensor
generate_external_monitor_sensor.description: Build the opcon_external_execution_monitor sensor. Cycles through every declared job, not just the first.

generate_inbound_trigger_sensor.label: Generate Inbound Trigger Sensor
generate_inbound_trigger_sensor.description: Build the opcon_inbound_trigger sensor. It only logs a simulated message in demo mode and does nothing in real mode until you wire a real webhook/event source -- off by default.

generate_force_restart_job.label: Generate Force Restart Job
generate_force_restart_job.description: Build the opcon_force_restart_job op-backed job. Off by default -- Dagster+'s own re-execution-from-failure covers most of this.

generate_hold_release_cancel_jobs.label: Generate Hold/Release/Cancel Jobs
generate_hold_release_cancel_jobs.description: Build the opcon_hold_job / opcon_release_job / opcon_cancel_job op-backed jobs.

generate_reconciliation.label: Generate Reconciliation
generate_reconciliation.description: Build the reconciliation op/job and its hourly schedule.

reconciliation_cron.label: Reconciliation Cron
reconciliation_cron.description: Cron for the OpCon vs Dagster state reconciliation job (only used when generate_reconciliation=true).

translation.label: Translation
translation.description: Optional per-job customization hook applied to each job's AssetSpec. group_name/kinds/deps/description/owners are REPLACED; tags/metadata are MERGED onto the component's defaults (Dagster framework behavior).

name: OpConIntegration
